summary: NORSK FORENING FOR ASSISTERT BEFRUKTNING-NOFAB (org. no. 987 487 666) is an association (FLI) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2004-12-04. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 94.992 (Aktiviteter i andre medlemsorganisasjoner ellers); it has 0 registered employees. Board chair: Åsmund Mjøen-Vigeland.
